about: Phase 5 (final MVP training) class list and the map from every source dataset's class name to it. Classes 0-29 are rod2's, unchanged, so the app's alert code keeps working. Classes 30-39 are new, each tied to the evidence in the plan. A source name that is not listed is dropped. Decided 13 Nov 2026 by Claude for Sudha (she asked Claude to decide); she can change any line. VIP-Mobility360 and GuideTWSI were filled in from the dataset audit on 13 Nov.

new_class_reasons.kerb: 71% report poor pavements; RNIB asks for detectable kerbs (In My Way 2025)
new_class_reasons.kerb_drop: a kerb seen from the pavement side, a step down; falls; the app says it cannot see drops (Barcelona Streets 'Curb-Down')
new_class_reasons.dropped_kerb: crossings: a barrier for 44%, vital for 89% (RNIB 2025)
new_class_reasons.e_scooter: 81% say bikes or e-scooters left on pavements make journeys harder (RNIB 2025); 78% met one (Guide Dogs 2022)
new_class_reasons.tactile_paving: crossings: blister paving marks UK crossing points
new_class_reasons.ped_signal: crossings; position only, its colour is never spoken
new_class_reasons.a_board: added 13 Nov after the audit: A-boards are a named pavement obstacle in RNIB In My Way; VIP-Mobility360 has about 14,000 labelled UK A-boards (class 0, Board), checked by eye

vistas-va-yolo640._dropped: street_light (14 Nov: these are lamp heads, median 1.5 px at 416, not poles)

pedestrian-lights-yolo640._note: 5 Roboflow Universe sets, CC BY 4.0 (ptl-rdoud v2, crosswalk_traffic_lights v2, pedestrian-traffic-lights v2, pedestrian-lights-adsir v1, pedestrian-path-signal-detection v2); red and green both mapped to ped_signal; 18,917 images, 19,549 boxes

open-images-trucks-poles._note: tools/fetch_openimages.py --classes truck,pole: more Truck boxes (rod3 lost Truck AP on 37 val boxes) and poles (Phase 2 has no pole boxes, so rod2 never learned Electrical Pole)

open-images-va-classes._dropped: wheelchair, scooter (could be a kick scooter), skateboard, door, parking_meter; ped_signal dropped because the Open Images class is every 'Traffic light', including the ones for cars

vip-mobility360-640px._names_from: no data.yaml; ids 0-7 = Board, Bollard, EScooter, Pothole, Puddle, RoadWork, TrashBag, WheelieBin from the XML <name> of 2,293 sampled train files (every vote unanimous) and the file-name prefixes; RoadWork pictures are barriers and road-works signs; checked by eye 13 Nov
vip-mobility360-640px._dropped: 4 Puddle and 6 TrashBag (not in the MVP scope; data kept for later). About one box per picture: other objects in a VIP picture are usually not labelled

guidetwsi._note: RBar-22k (real bar paving, class named braille) and RDome-2k (real dome paving) are polygons, turned into boxes; SDome-15k is synthetic and left out of the MVP

sanpo-walker-view-test-subset._note: semantic classes (curb, guard rail) have no instance ids: one box per connected patch above a minimum size

bristol-mapillary-test-set._note: no labels: pre-labelled by a separate open-vocabulary detector, then corrected by Claude on a stated sample
